material: Polyethylene terephthalate centrifuge tube disk, material 7

rinse_series.locator: Supplementary Figure S3 and Table S1
rinse_series.counted: Starting urine removed from the disk, each rinse separately, then the disk itself.
rinse_series.timing: Rinse dwell times and the delay to the final count were unspecified.
rinse_series.uncertainty: Markers overlap at low activity and the figure has no error bars.

five_hour_endpoint.locator: Supplementary Tables S4 and S2, material 7, 87 mg/L column
five_hour_endpoint.liquid_collection: Removed urine, five water rinses and the pipette tip were counted together.
five_hour_endpoint.uncertainty: The tables report group values without a condition-specific interval.

scope: These are separate experiments. Recovery in liquid and on the surface can be measured independently. Residual liquid and desorption can both contribute to a rinse. Timed surface release and the synthetic Cells binding parameters remain untested.
